Tailwind Play CDN 3.4.17, bundled for the isolated HTML demo preview.

Source: https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17
SHA-256: 176e894661aa9cdc9a5cba6c720044cbbf7b8bd80d1c9a142a7c24b1b6c50d15
License: Tailwind-LICENSE.txt (MIT); bundled dependency notices retained in the JS.

The original generated HTML remains unchanged. The preview substitutes this pinned
browser compiler for Tailwind CDN script tags, so streaming utilities work without
fetching or running arbitrary external scripts. This is a capability demo preview,
not a publishing pipeline for generated sites.
